lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Pale Choir death contract. Rustfang captain named Varrik. Hidden on Ashen Deep.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Sanctuary flagged it two hours ago. It's a direct hit.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I know them.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You remember?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I feel it. Don't know why.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The failsafe is holding. Heris bought us time. But if I'm going to spend it, I want answers.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Stand aside.

lines.speaker: Mortis (Voice Recording)
lines.text: The confessor does not remember his purpose. The Choir will remind him.

lines.speaker: Mortis (Voice Recording)
lines.text: Come to the Absolution. The Requiem Protocol will restore what the purge erased.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: This is a trap.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I've been carrying the shape of this place inside me without knowing what it was.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I need to know.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then I'm coming with you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Move!

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Excellent form. The purge didn't erase your body's knowledge.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Only the name for what you are.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Come. I will give you that name.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Before the Dominion transferred you to the Ronin Program, you trained here.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: As a confessor.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I don't remember.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Your katana carries a neural-link. It records the final moments of those you kill. Not for intelligence. For ritual.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: You were built to carry the dead. To absorb their final truths and hold them.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: The Dominion called this a weapon function. We call it sacred.

lines.speaker: Katana (Interior VO)
lines.text: He tells it crooked, but the bone of it is true. I said it once, we are a ledger written in carbon and iron. This is what the ledger was forged to hold.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Extract his final truth. Then absolve him.

lines.speaker: Varrik
lines.text: You're not a confessor! You're a predator! You eat souls!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm not what you think I am.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Refusing again. The Requiem Protocol activates regardless.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Your nature is returning whether you accept it or not.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: You heard him and chose not to drink.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: In eleven years of this nave, I have never seen that.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: I maintain the archive of confessions. Thousands of final moments.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: I know the difference between a predator that hungers and a vessel that carries.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Return to your duties, Sallow.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: He is what the design was meant to be before the Dominion weaponized it.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: He does not consume the dead. He holds them.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Contain them. The archivist will be disciplined.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: The full archive. Every confession recorded in this nave.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Not just syndicate secrets. The orders behind them. The names behind the names.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Why give this to me?

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Because you are the only person who has ever walked into this nave and carried the dead without being destroyed by the weight.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Someone should leave here with that burden and give it meaning.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Run. Send coordinates to your faction.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: You were magnificent, Cipher. But the confessor-link never sleeps.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: Sooner or later you will need what we built into you.

lines.speaker: Mortis
lines.text: The Absolution will be waiting.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Ten drones closing! Get out!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Get out!

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Eleven years of confessions.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: But some of them confessed to worlds, Cipher. Not people.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: The Dominion's cruelty is not limited to people. It murders whole worlds.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Cleanses them. Erases them. Leaves no name and no record.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The confessions.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Are the only record those worlds ever had.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You gave up everything. What's the price?

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Nothing. Or everything.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: I have spent eleven years recording the dead and handing the records to people who used them as leverage.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: I am done with leverage.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: If you are building something, if this man is going to do something with what he carries, I want to help.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You're the tenth.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: The tenth what?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ally.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Clean. One strike.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I was built to carry the dead and give their truth weight.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Dominion turned it into a weapon. The Choir turned it into a ritual.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I am going to turn it into a reckoning.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: The Pale Choir sings to absolve violence once committed.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: We never sang loud enough.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Then we'll sing louder.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Absolution is a sanctuary for the Pale Choir. Mortis is a High Deacon who trained me as a confessor, a vessel to carry the final truths of the dead through my katana's neural-link. It was never about consumption. It was about custody. Sallow, the Harmonian archivist, broke ranks and gave me the full confession archive, thousands of final moments, including those of worlds the Dominion murdered and erased.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Those confessions name planets, Cipher. Entire worlds the Dominion ordered cleansed. Full extinction, no survivors, no record. Except in the archive. Sallow gave you coordinates to every ordered genocide. That's the heading now, proof that those worlds existed, and a chance to speak their names before anyone else remembers to mourn them.
